meaning: Heating error: usually caused by a faulty thermistor (the washer's water temperature sensor).
causes: A faulty thermistor (temperature sensor), the usual cause LG gives
A temporary error that can clear after a power reset
diySteps: Plug it back in and press the Power button
Press the Spin Speed button until No Spin is highlighted, so the washer drains
Once the washer has drained, restart the wash cycle
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If tE persists, LG says to close the water taps and unplug the washer; the thermistor and heating circuit need an LG service technician.
